lines.t: Soft as the dawn, your mercy finds me
Washing the shadows off my face
You pull me close when I grow fragile
Wrapping my fears in gentle grace
Every breath I breathe is borrowed
Every heartbeat held by you
In the quiet you remind me
There is nothing you won't carry me through
When I feel lost you come and hold me
When I fall down you make me stand
Your love is steady, always calling
Guiding me back with open hands
Yeah, who should rub my rest, my quiet place
Your love pours over like a warm embrace
Here in your light, all fear is undone
I'm safe, I'm found in the arms of the sun
Yeah, who's you are the flame that makes me whole
The gentle healer of my soul
You lift the weight I could not bear
You breathe your peace into the air
You know the tears I never mention
You see the pain behind the smile
Yet still you meet me in the silence
Walking with me through every mile
You teach my heart to trust completely
To let the broken pieces mend
For in your presence I am learning
What it means to love again
When the world feels cold around me
You're the fire that warms the night
When I stumble in the darkness
You're the star that gives me sight
Child, come rest in me
We are now at Upper Session Road
Yahushua, my calm in the storm
My shelter of mercy forever adored
Hearing your whisper, I'm learning to breathe
You're healing my heart, you're making me free
Yahushua, you're the song in my night
The gentle flame, the guiding light
Hearing your love, I finally see
You are my peace, you are my peace
